answer.reason: The verses only list Libni among the sons of Gershon and in a line of descent, saying nothing of any deed or event of his, and the marked verses 1CH 23:7-9 and 26:21 concern Laadan and Shimei rather than him.
doubts: 1CH 23:7-9 and 1CH 26:21 are marked but name Laadan and Shimei, not Libni, so they were left out.
